name: trade-ticket
title: Trade ticket
description: Buy or sell one of two outcomes, with amount chips and the payout worked out as you type.

props.name: outcomes
props.description: Two outcomes, usually yes and no.

props.name: balance
props.description: Most someone can spend; the Max chip uses it.

a11y.text: A form: Enter in the amount field submits. Buy and sell, and the outcome choice, are buttons that toggle. The chips (+1, +5, +10, +100, Max, each with the currency symbol) are buttons. Submit is disabled while the amount is zero or less.

Buy and sell and the outcome choice are groups of buttons with aria-pressed. The amount has a label tied by htmlFor, inputMode decimal and no autocomplete, and the result is an output element. Outcome colours are paired with the label text.
The ticket uses Motion with reduced motion set to user.
